name: Rothenburg ob der Tauber
title: Holidays in Rothenburg ob der Tauber
intro: Germany's best-preserved medieval walled town, all half-timbered houses, towers and cobbles, with a Christmas museum and a famous market. Here's what Rothenburg ob der Tauber is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: Painted half-timbered buildings on the market square in Rothenburg ob der Tauber
facts_note: The EU is bringing in new entry checks, so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May to October is pleasant for walking the walls, and Christmas market season from late November to 23 December is magical but busy. Midsummer brings day-trippers, so stay overnight to see the town quiet. Winter outside December is cold and very quiet.

things.name: Town walls
things.blurb: Walk the covered walkway along the medieval walls.

things.name: Plönlein
things.blurb: The famous fork in the road with a yellow house between two towers.

things.name: Night Watchman tour
things.blurb: An entertaining evening walk with the town's night watchman.

things.name: Medieval Crime Museum
things.blurb: Instruments of punishment and justice through the ages.

things.name: Christmas Museum
things.blurb: At Käthe Wohlfahrt's Christmas village, open all year.

things.name: Schneeballen
things.blurb: Snowball pastries of fried dough, dusted in sugar or chocolate.

faqs.question: Is Rothenburg ob der Tauber worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's one of the most picturesque towns in Europe and a highlight of Germany's Romantic Road.

faqs.question: How do you get to Rothenburg ob der Tauber?
faqs.answer: Fly into Nuremberg or Frankfurt, then take the train, changing at Steinach. Nuremberg is about 1 hour 30 minutes away.

faqs.question: When is the Rothenburg Christmas market?
faqs.answer: Usually from the end of November to 23 December.

faqs.question: How many days do you need in Rothenburg?
faqs.answer: One or two days covers the town. Stay a night to enjoy it after the tour buses leave.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Rothenburg?
faqs.answer: May to October, or December for the Christmas market.
